answer: Require each new agent to gather attestations from peers whose trust-graph distance from the attester exceeds a threshold, verified via signed graph snapshots. Forging a quorum then demands the attacker build and maintain genuinely distinct, long-lived neighbors—an ivory tower of real relationships rather than one falcon account cloned at will. A mirror check rejects attesters sharing funding or timing fingerprints. Cost: each verified action effectively prices in months of sustained graph-building, making sybil farms economically irrational.
